elements.note: Allowed inline: a (href; http, https, mailto, tel, or an internal link), strong, em, code, br. Headings rank from the base level (section#body-heading-base); a heading outside the allowed set renders as p.

headings.children: base + 1 for the first heading tag, base + 2 for the second

zeroState: Not drawn when the body has no words (an editor's empty paragraph counts as none).

notes.text: Headings inside a body are relative to the section, not the absolute h3 and h4 WordPress's allow-list permits.

formerly.note: salt_sanitize_html output; allow-list p, a, strong, em, ul, ol, li, blockquote, h3, h4, br, code

owes: Wrap every body in div.salt-rich-text; map stored h3 and h4 to the base-relative levels.
